fixture_format.envelope_digest_rule: SHA-256 of json.dumps({all envelope members except envelope_digest}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False), encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters.
fixture_format.events: JSON array of complete v1 envelope objects, validated in array order.
fixture_format.events_mode_ledgers: Validators maintain sequence ledgers keyed by (source_id, session_ref) across the event list in order. capture_sequence and canonical_sequence must be strictly increasing per key; only accepted events advance a ledger, so a rejected event must not advance either watermark. Distinct source_ids have independent ledgers even when they share one session_ref.
fixture_format.expect: One entry per event/raw_event in the same order. Each entry is exactly {"accepted":true} or {"rejected_code":"NORMATIVE_CODE"}; never both.
fixture_format.id: Stable fixture identifier, unique in this manifest.
fixture_format.mode: "events" uses an events array of envelope objects; "raw" uses a raw_events array of exact JSON strings for duplicate-member cases.
fixture_format.neutral_scope: All values are synthetic neutral references and fixed integers. No provider, collection, market-shaped data, admitted dataset or live path is represented.
fixture_format.raw_events: JSON array of exact JSON strings, validated in array order without collapsing duplicate members.
fixture_format.raw_mode_duplicate_rule: Duplicate JSON members are detected before digest recomputation and rejected as UNKNOWN_OR_MISSING_MEMBER. For NEG-009 the recorded envelope_digest is the digest of the equivalent unique-member object, making the duplicate member the sole defect.
